response.courseDescription: 349 Principles of Solid State Devices Semiconductor theory; carrier diffusion and drift, direct and indirect energy materials, homo and hetereojunctions, operations principles of bipolar junctions and MOS field effect transistors, metal-semiconductor contacts.
response.coursePrerequisites: ECE 325 or concurrent enrollment; CHEM 105; 4 credits PHYSICS 202, or PHYSICS 202 and 212.
